bill.title: An original resolution authorizing expenditures by the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry.
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the Committee on Rules and Administration. (text: CR S671)
subjects: Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry
bill.officialSummary: This resolution authorizes the Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry to make specified expenditures and employ personnel for the 119th Congress.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
